reasonCode.description: The return reason of an AUTHORIZED RMA.

rejectionCode.description: Present only on a REJECTED RMA; the API never stores one today (a refusal is a 409), so it is not served.

status.description:
Lifecycle state of an RMA. `REJECTED` and `CLOSED` are terminal:
nothing leaves them. Through this API an RMA is only ever created
`AUTHORIZED`: a refused authorization persists nothing, and no
operation moves an RMA to `RECEIVED` or `CLOSED` today.

windowEndsAt.description: The last instant goods may arrive; present once AUTHORIZED.

version.description: Starts at 1, +1 per accepted transition; guards every write (409 on a lost update).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.
